milestone.title: mp agent output contract cleanup — JSON default, decoupling debt audit

intent.outcome: mp stdout is unconditionally JSON for agents with no ceremony flags; vestigial human/dual-audience code paths from pre-M41 are removed or moved to raul; docs/skills teach `mp <cmd>` not `mp <cmd> --format json`.

problem.description: M41 made mp agent-only and M40/M45 split human display to raul, but the codebase and docs still carry dual-audience habits: `--format json` is taught everywhere despite being the default; `OutputFormat::Human` remains as a clap alias; `mp search` still renders ASCII tables; `render_verify_human()` builds prose that is never emitted; `output.default_format` config is dead; STORAGE.md still documents human/raw/TTY defaults from v1; raul's mp_runner defensively passes `--format json` on every shell-out. This adds agent token noise, confuses the contract (JSON API vs TOML file debug), and leaves human-format logic in mp where raul should own it.

in_scope: Audit matrix: enumerate every mp output-format touchpoint (cli.rs enum, emit(), search.rs, graph.rs, show/list toml passthrough, config output.*, tests, golden scenarios, docs, templates/skills, raul mp_runner) with keep/move/remove decision per item
Remove OutputFormat::Human from clap + all match arms; delete dead human render paths (search ASCII table, render_verify_human, emit human param if unused)
Clarify --format toml scope: debug/raw-file passthrough only (show milestone, archived entity); document that list/generic emit toml is deprecated or removed if redundant with JSON
Docs/skills pass: AGENTS.md, master-planner SKILL, MP-COMMANDS, AGENT-PLAYBOOK, AGENT-READINESS, STORAGE.md — teach `mp <cmd>` default JSON; fix stale human/raw/next-step/pr-body references
raul mp_runner: stop appending --format json (rely on default); keep explicit json only where tests require stability
Tests: assert default output (no --format flag) is valid JSON on core reads; update format_dispatch and golden scenarios; keep json_shape_baseline intact
Remove or wire output.default_format and output.color from config schema (prefer delete if unused)
CHANGELOG + ADR note documenting agent stdout contract post-decoupling
out_of_scope: Adding new raul commands or TUI features (only move/delete mp human paths, not expand raul scope)
Changing --format json output shapes (D-011 freeze holds — behavior change is default-only and flag removal, not schema drift)
Compact/minified JSON mode or streaming NDJSON (separate future milestone)
Fixing the 67-milestone review backlog (orthogonal process debt)

acceptance_criteria.description: Core read commands emit valid JSON with no --format flag (mp status, mp next, mp list milestones, mp show milestone <id>, mp validate)
OutputFormat::Human removed; clap rejects --format human with clear error
No human table rendering remains in mp search or milestone verify

acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — AGENTS.md SKILL AGENT-READINESS STORAGE MP-COMMANDS updated

acceptance_criteria.description: raul mp_runner relies on mp JSON default (no --format json on every call)
Dead output.default_format config removed or honored consistently (not orphaned)
